card.name: Patient weight in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word "weight" when dose is said to depend on or be calculated from a patient's weight, often after "age," or "based on". Rarely fires on an odd name such as Ceres.

modes.label: Weight as dosing basis
modes.description: The word weight in phrases saying dose is based on or calculated from the patient's weight.

modes.label: Listed patient factors
